# Upstream attribution

`rules.ts` is copied unmodified from Focuser v0.10.0, commit `365300133d0eab68b3f9e4be0758d240c46a1b91`.
Source: https://github.com/aadeshrao123/Focuser/blob/v0.10.0/extension/lib/rules.ts

`rules.js` is compiled with TypeScript 5.9.3 (`--target ES2022 --module ES2022`).
Copyright (c) 2026 Focuser Contributors. MIT license in `LICENSE-Focuser.txt`.

Screen Time Local reuses this pure domain matching module. Its Python budget engine,
Windows process monitor, browser bridge and dashboard are separate new code; this
is not the upstream Focuser desktop application or a full compatibility fork.
